objective: one bounded live exposure of the current renewable model-authored cover contract before adding one-way visual invalidation
stop_rule: retain the first run at 12 decisions, death, model terminal state, runtime failure, or independent episode end; no retry of this allocation
exposure_rule: report whether a visible-threat assessment authors nonempty next_cover and whether that exact semantic policy is accepted and executes during the next inference interval
staleness_question: retain observation, cover admission/renewal/release boundaries and the following model view needed to judge whether the repeated policy remained appropriate as the screen changed
guard_rule: do not integrate the posthoc one-way ROI candidate into this allocation; use this run to decide whether a newly versioned guarded allocation is justified
acceptance_limit: mechanism evidence requires linked next-turn policy identity, exact 10000ms compilation, accepted programs, verified releases and retained frames; survival, kill, health or progress alone does not prove benefit
no_exposure_disposition: retain as unexposed and do not retry this allocation
failure_disposition: retain exact failure and diagnose before any differently versioned run
scope: single live Linux/X11 allocation; no reliability, causal survival, generality, human-speed, Product Hunt completion or MAP01-clear claim
